entry.title: The Gospels
entry.tagline: Six movements. Four witnesses. One life, told four times over — read slowly, in the old manner.

grounds.label: I. Coptic Weave
grounds.alt: Close-up of a Coptic Christian wool tapestry fragment in deep burgundy, indigo and ochre with stylised crosses and lozenges

grounds.label: II. Byzantine Gold Ground
grounds.alt: Byzantine gold mosaic of very fine hand-set tesserae with a small ship on stylised waves

grounds.label: III. Carved Stone
grounds.alt: Anglo-Saxon carved slate cross slab with deep Insular interlace under raking light

grounds.label: IV. Gothic Glass
grounds.alt: Detail of a Gothic stained glass window in cobalt and ruby pot-metal glass with lead cames

grounds.label: V. Ivory Diptych
grounds.alt: Medieval ivory diptych panel carved in low relief with the Annunciation, warm creamy surface and fine crackle

grounds.label: VI. Limoges Enamel
grounds.note: cobalt glass · gilt copper · jewel box
grounds.alt: Medieval Limoges enamel plaque in deep cobalt blue with raised gilt-copper figures and scrolling foliage

grounds.label: VII. Floor Mosaic
grounds.alt: Byzantine floor mosaic fragment with a personification of Ktisis in marble and glass tesserae, warm ochre and rose

grounds.label: IX. Pot-Metal Glass
grounds.note: martyrdom of st lawrence · ca. 1180 · the met
grounds.alt: Romanesque stained glass panel of the martyrdom of Saint Lawrence in cobalt, ruby and green pot-metal glass

grounds.label: X. Armenian Gospels
grounds.note: four gospels · 1434/35 · illuminated manuscript · the met
